about_lead: TurnuVolt is a tournament maker app for friends, schools, offices and clubs. Type in the teams and the league or knockout fixtures are created for you. As you enter scores the standings table updates itself, and when the final is over the champion takes the podium. It supports 63 sports and games, from soccer to chess and tennis to FIFA, and scores each one by its own rules.

faq_home: How do I make a fixture with TurnuVolt?

Tap New Tournament, enter a tournament name and the number of teams, choose the game and the format (league or knockout), then type the team names. The fixtures and the standings table are created automatically; all you do is enter the scores.
Which sports and games are supported?

63 in total, including soccer, futsal, basketball, volleyball, tennis, table tennis, padel, badminton, chess, backgammon, darts, pool, FIFA and Valorant. For anything else there is a Custom / Other option.
What is the difference between a league and a knockout?

In a league (round robin) everyone plays everyone and the table decides the winner; you can make it a double round robin with home and away legs. In a knockout the loser is out and the winners advance until the final.
What happens with an odd number of teams?
In a league one team has a bye each round. In a knockout the teams that get a bye in the first round are chosen automatically and go straight through to the next round.

As you enter scores, games played, wins, draws, losses, goal difference and points update automatically. The points rule depends on the game: in soccer a win is 3 points and a draw 1; basketball has no draws; in volleyball set difference counts too.
Do I need an internet connection? Where is my data stored?
No connection is needed. Your tournaments are stored only on your device; there is no account, no personal data is collected and nothing is sent to a server.
The app is a one-time purchase on the App Store, with no subscription, no ads and no in-app purchases. The fixture generator in your browser is completely free.
The Android version is coming soon to Google Play. Right now TurnuVolt is available for iPhone and iPad (iOS 17.6 or later).

fx_h2_how: How is a round-robin fixture made?
fx_p_how1_html: In a league (round robin) every team plays every other team once. The fixture is built with the circle method, also known as Berger tables: one team stays fixed while the others rotate one place each round. That way no pairing repeats and every team plays at most one match per round.
fx_p_how2_html: A league of n teams has n × (n − 1) ÷ 2 matches in total. With an even number of teams it takes n − 1 rounds, with an odd number n rounds, and one team has a bye in each round. A double round robin (home and away) doubles the matches and rounds, with home and away swapped in the second half.
fx_table_caption: Matches and rounds by number of teams (single round robin)
fx_p_ko1_html: In a knockout (single elimination) the loser is out. If the number of teams is not a power of two (4, 8, 16, 32…), some teams get a bye in the first round. The number of byes is the next power of two minus the number of teams: with 6 teams 8 − 6 = 2 teams get a bye, with 10 teams 16 − 10 = 6.
fx_p_ko2_html: A knockout with n teams always has n − 1 matches, because exactly one team is eliminated in each match. A 16-team tournament takes 4 rounds and 15 matches.
fx_p_points_html: In games like soccer a win is worth 3 points, a draw 1 and a loss 0; teams level on points are separated by goal difference, then goals scored. In games without draws, like basketball, a win is worth 2 points. In volleyball a 3-0 or 3-1 win earns 3 points, a 3-2 win 2 points and a 2-3 loss 1 point. TurnuVolt applies these rules automatically for the game you choose.
faq_fx: Yes. No sign-up and no ads. The fixture is made in your browser and your team names are never sent anywhere.
How many teams can I add?
You can make a league or knockout fixture for 2 to 64 teams.
Can I make a league fixture with an odd number of teams?
Yes. One team has a bye each round, and by the end of the league every team has played the same number of matches.
What is a double round robin?
A fixture where every pairing is played twice, with home and away swapped in the second half. It doubles the number of matches.
Can I print or share the fixture?
Yes. Print gives you a clean printout, Copy puts the fixture on your clipboard as text, and Copy link creates a link that opens the same fixture.
How do I track scores and standings?
Set up the same tournament in the TurnuVolt app. As you enter scores the standings, goal difference and rankings are calculated automatically, and winners advance through the bracket on their own.
